title: When the Homecoming Turns
author: Theo Lockridge
blurb: Wren Sterling, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
